_description: NCBI Taxonomy species-rank record counts per Acanthuridae genus, used as the denominator for the Species section's taxon-sampling percentages. Independently queried and hand-classified for this project (not taken from any audit tool's own count) - see 'excluded' for interspecific hybrids and provisional/BOLD placeholder names that carry NCBI Taxonomy rank=species but are not valid, describable binomial species.
_method: esearch db=taxonomy term='<Genus>[Subtree] AND species[Rank]', then esummary on the returned IDs to classify each ScientificName as a real binomial vs. a hybrid/aff./cf./sp./BOLD placeholder.
_caveat: NCBI Taxonomy is a sequence-database index, not a taxonomic authority for fishes - it will not perfectly match Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes or FishBase. Treat these as a reasonable, checkable denominator, not the final word.
